exposure: Multidisciplinary team-developed interventions (targeting structure, process, team members, and patient engagement) based on failure modes and effects analysis and process mapping.
outcome: Percentage of first case on-time starts (FCOTS) in L&D ORs
cohort: The study was conducted within the Labour and Delivery operating rooms of a safety-net hospital, focusing on the efficiency of first case on-time starts.
finding: The interventions led to a 41% increase in the average percentage of on-time first cases (from 12% to 53%) and a 69% decrease in average case delay (from 178 minutes to 55 minutes).
